summary: Iteration 3 (Playdate creation w/ private_note, Saved Resources, Match Reasons) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (test_iteration3.py): 7/7 PASS — POST /api/playdates returns id + private_note; GET /api/playdates/{id} exposes private_note only to host (verified with second signup user — hidden for non-host); every item in GET /api/playdates carries match_reasons (list) + match_score (int); POST /api/resources/{id}/save marks saved=true, unsave clears it, GET /api/profile/saved-resources returns items in reverse-chronological order (rs-3, rs-2, rs-1 after saving in that order). Frontend Expo web preview (390x844): Sign-in via signin-email-input/signin-password-input/signin-submit-button works. Home lists 8 playdate cards each with a *-reasons chip row ('Why it matches'). Playdates tab → pd-add opens Host a playdate screen; all 14 requested testIDs present (create-title, create-cat-park, create-location, create-date, create-start, create-end, create-agemin, create-agemax, create-max, create-desc, create-sensory-quiet, create-interest-nature, create-private, create-submit). Submitting a valid form (title/location/date + private note) navigated to /playdate/pd-35ae98e7 with playdate-reasons chips AND playdate-private-note visible to the host. On seeded pd-park, playdate-reasons visible, playdate-private-note correctly hidden. Resources page: 5 bookmark-{id} buttons, resources-kind-saved chip present with count badge '2', filter shows 2 resource-* rows after saving two items. Profile: 2 profile-saved-* rows shown (no profile-empty-saved since 2 are saved). All acceptance criteria for the review request met.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/playdate-card.tsx:86 (and other files using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). Non-blocking but repeats in console.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence deprecation warnings on RN Web.
(Carryover from iter 2) server.py ~870 lines — consider splitting seed data + feature routers.
critical_code_review_comments: match_details() correctly dedupes reasons preserving order and caps at 3 — matches spec.
GET /api/playdates/{id} correctly pops private_note when caller is neither host nor attendee (server.py:326-327).
POST /api/playdates trims private_note and stores None when blank — good.
GET /api/profile/saved-resources sorts by saved_at DESC and re-orders after find() to preserve chronology — good.
Resources list decorates saved=true from saved_resources collection — no leakage across users.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new + all prior iter 1&2 endpoints unchanged)
